kompaniya_rustrak_predostavlya: The Rustrak company provides the opportunity to purchase special-purpose vehicles on credit and on lease.
my_rabotaem_so_vsemi_bankami_i: We work with all banks and leasing companies.Remember, you can choose any leasing company that suits you.
summa_avansa_5_30_ot_stoimosti: The advance amount is 5-30% of the cost of the equipment.Increase in price of the leased asset per year by 8-9%.The lease payment period ranges from 6 months to 5 years.After full payment for leasing, the equipment becomes the property of your company.
maksimalnaya_otsrochka_platezh: Maximum deferment of payment.Accelerated depreciation: participants in a leasing transaction have the right to use the mechanism of accelerated depreciation of the leased asset with an acceleration factor of up to 3, which allows the equipment to be repaid faster and the duration of the leasing agreement can be varied.Tax optimization: all payments made under a leasing agreement are included in the cost of production, thereby reducing the tax base for income tax.Saving money for the lessee as a result of not having to pay property tax, becauseIn most cases, the leased asset is on the balance sheet of the leasing company.The opportunity to acquire and use property without diverting the company’s own funds at a time and in full.Possibility of acquiring ownership of the leased asset, completely exempt from the tax burden, upon expiration of the leasing agreement.Independent choice of the leased asset and its seller by the lessee.
lizingodatel_lizingovaya_kompa: The lessor (leasing company) acquires ownership of the property specified by the lessee from a specific seller and transfers this property to the lessee as a leased asset under certain conditions for temporary possession and use.The property (the subject of leasing) becomes the property of the lessee, subject to the payment by the lessee of all leasing payments.
imushchestvo_ne_vykupaetsya_li: The property is not purchased by the lessee, but remains the property of the leasing company and, after the expiration of the leasing agreement, is again leased or leased.
predpriyatie_pokupaet_imushche: The company buys property with its own funds and then turns to a leasing company.This is one of the ways to quickly return working capital.The leasing company considers the property as a leased item and acquires it under a purchase and sale agreement from the enterprise.The same property is leased to the same enterprise.

kompaniya_carcade_eto_universa: CARCADE company is a universal leasing partner.CARCADE finances the purchase of both passenger cars and commercial vehicles.You can lease commercial vehicles or special equipment without providing financial statements based on 2 documents.Terms of the transaction: advance from 4% to 50%, leasing term from 12 to 60 months, last payment from 1% to 15%.Additional benefits for CARCADE clients: comprehensive insurance in installments, free assignment, electronic document management.

kompaniya_rustrak_vedushchiy_p: The RusTrak company is a leading manufacturer of commercial vehicles and specialized equipment in Nizhny Novgorod.Our products include vans, flatbeds, cranes, workshops, food tanks, hydraulic lifts, dump trucks, vacuum machines and fuel tankers.All cars are manufactured in-house.
proizvodstvennye_moshchnosti_r: RusTrak production facilities consist of 3 buildings with a total area of more than 7,000 square meters.The machine park is equipped with modern high-tech equipment, which determines the high quality of the finished product.The company uses components from well-known global and domestic manufacturers.Today the company's productivity is from 110 units per month.
zalog_kachestva_produkcii_ooo_: The guarantee of the quality of RusTrak LLC products is the work of a team of professionals using the company’s high-tech machine tools.The company's management takes care of its employees, creating the most comfortable working conditions and improving the professional training of employees.Every six months, the company's employees undergo recertification of knowledge and skills and take advanced training courses.
kompaniya_rustrak_imeet_sobstv: The RusTrak company has its own design and technology bureau, which works in close cooperation with production.This scheme of work allows us to constantly improve and modernize the special equipment produced, taking into account the wishes of our customers.We are ready to make a car for almost any need!
kontrol_kachestva_nashey_produ: Quality control of our products is carried out at all stages of production.We use only reliable components, purchasing them from trusted suppliers.RusTrak specialists strictly monitor the implementation of production technology.Constant testing and testing of manufactured products eliminates any complaints.The production has introduced a global practice of product conformity certification: for each unit of special equipment that leaves our production, there is an international certificate (ISO 9001).
otdel_kontrolya_kachestva_ocen: The quality control department evaluates each piece of equipment, which guarantees our customers a long service life and trouble-free operation of the equipment.

logisticheskaya_sfera_opiraets: The logistics sector relies on the sustainable operation of trailers.Repair of curtain side semi-trailers ensures the restoration of the structure's functionality after intensive use.Our craftsmen take into account the design features of the units and use proven maintenance methods.The Rustrak company in Nizhny Novgorod offers a service focused on the quality and durability of equipment.Timely technical measures maintain the stable condition of trailers under intense loads.A reliable approach to maintenance builds confidence in the smooth operation of equipment.
kompaniya_rustrak_vypolnyaet_p: The Rustrak company carries out complete repairs of semi-trailers in Nizhny Novgorod after damage or failure.We restore the trailer structure, repair the frame and side covers, repair doors, locks and opening mechanisms, and restore the trailer floor and sides.All work is carried out with high precision and compliance with quality standards, which guarantees the durability of the restored elements.
remont_hodovoy_dvigatelya_zame: Chassis and engine repairs, oil changes and scheduled maintenance are not performed.
remont_shtornyh_polupricepov_p: Repairing curtain side semi-trailers helps extend the life of the equipment and maintain its functionality.Contact our team for reliable and discreet service.The Rustrak company in Nizhny Novgorod performs work with attention to detail and strict quality standards.Entrust us with technical tasks and get a result that will meet your expectations.Schedule your service in advance and experience the convenience of our service.To start cooperation, contact us in any convenient way, and we will help organize everything quickly and professionally.
